name: Library scripts
description: Runs the library scripts in the level that is loaded: trace-method-calls on an overloaded name, whose every overload it patches, and on a method the type inherits, patched on its declaring type for calls on the named type only; spawn-capture and dump-harmony-patches on that inherited method; trace-method-calls and spawn-capture on BroBase's inherited MustBroFailToWin, called on a mook the script spawns beside the bro and deactivates, which neither records, and on player 1's bro, which each records once; inspect-private-fields and watch-field on a private field a base class declares; watch-field's object still active under the pause menu; trace-method-calls and spawn-capture refusing a type the script system compiled; and diff-component on an inactive object named by a path with no leading slash. Needs RocketLib, and a vanilla bro or one derived from BroBase for player 1. Its first step closes a pause menu and destroys the probe and mook an earlier run left; its last step destroys them, and its cleanup closes the pause menu, destroys them and unloads every script it ran.
